'''Jizzy B.''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] and an infamous nightclub-owning pimp who appears as a minor antagonist in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. Living in [[San Fierro]], he owns the city's famous [[The Pleasure Domes Club|Pleasure Domes Club]] under the [[Gant Bridge]], an adult entertainment place where he surrounds himself with [[prostitutes]] whom he abuses. Jizzy is a member of the [[Loco Syndicate]], a drug cartel based in San Fierro. He acts as the cartel's face and charisma, recruiting men to pull hits, errands and other business for the Syndicate's dealings.

Looking to avenge his brother [[Sweet|Sean "Sweet" Johnson]]'s arrest, protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] becomes aware of the "big deal" between the Loco Syndicate and representatives working for former friend and [[Grove Street Families]] defaulter [[Big Smoke|Melvin "Big Smoke" Harris]] and his crack empire, and decides to use Jizzy to learn about the Syndicate's business deals. Blind Chinese-American [[San Fierro Triads]] leader [[Wu Zi Mu|Wu Zi "Woozie" Mu]] informs Carl that the 'big deal' meeting is with Smoke's lieutenant and former high-ranking [[Grove Street Families]] member [[Ryder|Lance "Ryder" Wilson]] and the [[Ballas]], and Carl has to take Jizzy's phone in order to find out about where the meeting will take place. Carl then kills Jizzy as he tries to escape in his [[Broadway]].

Jizzy was voiced by the late [[Charlie Murphy]].

==Trivia==
[[File:Mobilephone-GTASA-JizzyB..jpg|thumb|left|200px|Jizzy's [[Mobile Phone|phone]] in GTA San Andreas.]]
*Jizzy owns a special [[Broadway]] which has purple seats with a beech-color paint job and a license plate which reads ''HO 2 HO''.
*Jizzy can be heard on the show Lonely Hearts on [[West Coast Talk Radio|WCTR]] he says that some of the female callers can come down to the Pleasure Domes and be his hookers before being scolded by Christy MacIntyre.
*As Jizzy is a pimp his name could be slang for sperm bee.
*Jizzy's name is derived from the vulgarity "jizz," a slang term for semen.
